python3 << 'EOF'
import semver

# R1: Immutability test
vi = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print("R1: Testing immutability...")
try:
    vi.major = 2
    print("FAIL: Should have raised AttributeError")
except AttributeError:
    print("PASS: Cannot set major attribute")

try:
    vi.prerelease = "beta"
    print("FAIL: Should have raised AttributeError")
except AttributeError:
    print("PASS: Cannot set prerelease attribute")

# R2: Iteration test
print("\nR2: Testing iteration...")
result = list(vi)
expected = [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1']
if result == expected:
    print(f"PASS: {result}")
else:
    print(f"FAIL: Expected {expected}, got {result}")

# R3: Tuple comparison test
print("\nR3: Testing tuple comparison...")
v1 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
v2 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 4)
tuple1 = (1, 2, 3)
tuple2 = (1, 2, 4)

if v1 == tuple1:
    print("PASS: v1 == (1, 2, 3)")
else:
    print("FAIL: v1 should equal (1, 2, 3)")

if v2 > tuple1:
    print("PASS: v2 > (1, 2, 3)")
else:
    print("FAIL: v2 should be greater than (1, 2, 3)")

# Test that string comparison is disallowed
try:
    result = v1 == "1.2.3"
    if result is NotImplemented or isinstance(result, bool) and not result:
        print("PASS: String comparison handled correctly")
    else:
        print(f"Result of string comparison: {result}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"String comparison exception: {e}")

# Test integer comparison
try:
    result = v1 == 123
    if result is NotImplemented:
        print("PASS: Integer comparison returns NotImplemented")
    else:
        print(f"Result of int comparison: {result}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Integer comparison exception: {e}")

# R4: Bump methods test
print("\nR4: Testing bump methods...")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'rc.1', 'build.5')
bumped_major = v.bump_major()
print(f"bump_major: {v} -> {bumped_major}")
assert str(bumped_major) == "2.0.0", f"Expected 2.0.0, got {bumped_major}"

bumped_minor = v.bump_minor()
print(f"bump_minor: {v} -> {bumped_minor}")
assert str(bumped_minor) == "1.3.3", f"Expected 1.3.3, got {bumped_minor}"

bumped_patch = v.bump_patch()
print(f"bump_patch: {v} -> {bumped_patch}")
assert str(bumped_patch) == "1.2.4", f"Expected 1.2.4, got {bumped_patch}"

bumped_pre = v.bump_prerelease()
print(f"bump_prerelease: {v} -> {bumped_pre}")
assert str(bumped_pre) == "1.2.3-rc.2", f"Expected 1.2.3-rc.2, got {bumped_pre}"

bumped_build = v.bump_build()
print(f"bump_build: {v} -> {bumped_build}")
assert str(bumped_build) == "1.2.3+build.6", f"Expected 1.2.3+build.6, got {bumped_build}"

# R5: Type conversion test
print("\nR5: Testing type conversion...")
v_ints = semver.VersionInfo('1', '2', '3')  # strings passed in
print(f"major type: {type(v_ints.major)}, value: {v_ints.major}")
assert isinstance(v_ints.major, int), "major should be int"
assert v_ints.major == 1

v_str_parts = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 123, 456)  # ints for prerelease/build
print(f"prerelease type: {type(v_str_parts.prerelease)}, value: {v_str_parts.prerelease}")
assert isinstance(v_str_parts.prerelease, str), "prerelease should be str"
assert v_str_parts.prerelease == "123"

# R6: CLI functions test
print("\nR6: Testing CLI functions...")
assert hasattr(semver, 'createparser'), "Missing createparser"
assert hasattr(semver, 'main'), "Missing main"
assert hasattr(semver, 'process'), "Missing process"
print("PASS: All CLI functions exist")

# R7: Replace function test
print("\nR7: Testing replace...")
# Module level replace
result_str = semver.replace('1.2.3', minor=5)
print(f"semver.replace('1.2.3', minor=5) = '{result_str}'")
assert result_str == "1.5.3", f"Expected 1.5.3, got {result_str}"

# VersionInfo.replace method
v = semver.VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3')
new_v = v.replace(minor=5, patch=9)
print(f"VersionInfo.replace: {v} -> {new_v}")
assert str(new_v) == "1.5.9", f"Expected 1.5.9, got {new_v}"

print("\n=== All manual tests passed! ===")
EOF
